title: LL-979: The Acorn Explorer
description: 1979 Classic Space meets an Ewok launch village. A blue-and-grey explorer with twin yellow cockpits, woven glider wings and acorn hover engines waits on a timber launch cradle. Suited Ewoks prepare the flight from thatched mission huts joined by a rope bridge; a woodcrawler collects forest fuel below. The forest itself is the spaceport.
